skillFull: Launches Blue Slushy Arrows and takes flight at regular intervals. While in flight, the launched arrows descend one by one, destroying nearby obstacles and creating Blue Slushy Jellies. Level Up for more points for Blue Slushy Jellies.
story: In Dessert Paradise, above the sky was a bluebird Cookie nestled beneath the cool soda waterfall. Blue Slushy Cookie is known for her relentless chirping! The large scoop of frozen blue soda on top of the refreshing frozen lake water has given her a crisp and delightful voice. From the moment Blue Slushy Cookie began to flutter her wings, she dreamt of becoming a Dessert Guardian. Oddly enough, the Cookie showed little interest in training but was always busy soaring through Dessert Paradise to bring back the latest news. Blue Slushy Cookie is overflowing with enthusiasm, even though her ambition might be greater than her skills for now. Nevertheless, if she continues to chase her dreams, who knows? She just might stand by Sugar Swan Cookie's side as an invaluable guardian someday!

costumes.name: Glacial Waltz
costumes.info: Meet Blue Slushy Cookie, now graced with the wings of a true guardian. Wearing lavender shoes, she soars over the lake, making ice pillars rise up with little stars. The movement of this dream-fulfilled bird resemble a joyful waltz!

costumes.name: Yakgwa Village Envoy
costumes.info: Today's mission: Bring delicious treats from Yakgwa Village all the way back to Dessert Paradise! Blue Slushy Cookie takes on this crucial mission with pride, even topping her icing with a special feathered hat marking her as a Dessert Guardian. One glance across Yakgwa Village reveals countless new, fascinating things to see—from clothing carefully crafted from honey and flour to eye-catching fan dance performances paired with music to make any Cookie's dough move! The Dessert Guardian's eyes sparkle as she explores the village until sundown.

costumes.name: Dessert Forest Elf
costumes.info: Get ready for the fantasy film of the year, The Fellowship of the Jelly. It's about a journey to rid the One Jelly that will taint the world with wickedness. Taking on the role of an elf from the Dessert Forest is none other than Blue Slushy Cookie. While giving it her all on set because "acting is in her nature," there's a slight hiccup! It turns out that shooting rubber arrows a bit too high makes them stick to the lights. Let's aim a little lower next time!

candy.skillFull: Blue Slushy Arrow Jellies are created at regular intervals. Upon obtaining a Blue Slushy Arrow Jelly, you can fire a Blue Slushy Arrow ahead to destroy obstacles and create Blue Slushy Jellies. The stronger the enchanted power, the more points obtained from Blue Slushy Jellies.
